q: We estimated December's electricity in our report. What do we do when the real bill arrives?
title: Fixing an estimated bill later
short: Replace the estimate with the actual bill in your records. If the difference is small, note it and carry on. If it is material, restate last year's total and say why. Keep both figures and the date you corrected it, so a verifier can follow the change.
audience: Teams closing their inventory before all bills arrive

ul: Label every estimate and its method when you report.
Swap in actual bills as they arrive.
Restate only when the change crosses your materiality threshold.

p: Quietly adding the difference to next year. That makes both years wrong.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.
